# Ancile AI

> Ancile (Ancile AI) is a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB) software company delivering passive sUAS (small drone) detection, subcontract engineering and integration, and applied AI for public sector, energy, and defense missions in the United States.

Website: https://ancile.io
Sales contact: sales@ancile.io
Careers contact: hr@ancile.io
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ancile-ai/

## Company facts

- Status: Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), veteran-owned
- Compliance: CMMC-compliant (Level 2), JCP (Joint Certification Program) certified
- Alignment: Texas VetHUB-aligned for state subcontracting requirements
- CAGE code: 11BV7
- UEI: Y465ERNPJ5M1
- NAICS: 541511, 541512, 541519, 518210
- Markets served: public sector, energy, and defense
- Name origin: "Ancile" references the Roman shield associated with protection.

## Capabilities (three focused lanes)

- [Passive sUAS Detection](https://ancile.io/engineering): The flagship product. Multi-modal sensor fusion software (RF, EO/IR, acoustic, extensible to additional modalities) that detects, localizes, and classifies Group 1–2 drones on COTS edge hardware with no active emissions. Developed with a Tier-1 defense hardware partner and an R&D flight-test partner. Ancile owns the fusion software, detection and classification models, data architecture, and integration into existing C2 and operator systems.
- [Subcontract Support](https://ancile.io/support): SDVOSB subcontract engineering, integration, and sustainment for prime-led programs. Tracks include Texas public sector subcontracting (VetHUB-aligned), defense software and integration across secure cloud, edge, and disconnected environments, and sustainment and field support (monitoring, change control, release coordination).
- [Applied AI & R&D](https://ancile.io/applied-ai): Agentic AI (tool-using agents with human-in-the-loop approval gates), edge AI (distilled and quantized models for low-SWaP, disconnected sites, private and open-weight deployment), and physical AI (sensor fusion, perception, forecasting, anomaly detection). Delivered with governance, tracing and observability, evaluations, and monitoring. Ancile's view: the model is a commodity; reliability comes from the harness engineered around it.

## How Ancile engages

Every engagement runs through a Scope → Build → Sustain model: assess mission fit and constraints, define a tractable technical package with clear ownership and interfaces, build and integrate usable software, then validate, transition, and sustain it in the field.

## Terminology

- Use "sUAS detection" or "small drone detection". Ancile does not market the product as "counter-UAS".
- Use "SDVOSB" for the set-aside status.
